connector.name: Fundamentals MCP
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial read-only MCP for fundamentals, macro & news (EDGAR + FRED + Tavily, BYO-key).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package fundamentals-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the simontarara62 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FUND_ENV_FILE

env.name: FUND_EDGAR_USER_AGENT
env.description: User-Agent for SEC EDGAR requests; required for resolve_instrument / get_fundamentals.

env.name: FUND_FRED_API_KEY
env.description: FRED API key; required for get_macro.

env.name: FUND_TAVILY_API_KEY
env.description: Tavily API key; required for get_news.
